add.title: LGBTQ people in prison (Wikipedia; New Zealand section)
add.summary: New Zealand: citing Dalzell, Pang & Broemdal 2024 (Australian & New Zealand Journal of Psychiatry, 'Gender affirmation and mental health in prison'), the article reports that trans people in New Zealand prisons are more likely to have prior experience of abuse and show a higher rate of incarceration, and that the NZ government has declared support for gender-affirming healthcare and gender-affirming clothing for incarcerated persons. No placement rule (birth-sex vs identity housing), special unit, or solitary/segregation practice for New Zealand is described.
